identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of B013 in Combination With Paclitaxel in Patients With Platinum-resistant Recurrent Ovarian Cancer.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Parallel-controlled Phase II Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of B013 Combined With Paclitaxel in the Treatment of Platinum-resistant Recurrent Ovarian Cancer, Fallopian Tube Cancer, or Primary Peritoneal Cancer.

leadSponsor.name: Shanghai Jiaolian Drug Research and Development Co., Ltd

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of B013 in patients with platinum-resistant recurrent ovarian cancer.

interventions.name: B013
interventions.description: B013: The subjects will receive IV dose of B013 600 mg on Day 1 and 15 of the first 28-day cycle, then on Day 1 of each subsequent 28-day cycle.

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: Paclitaxel: 80 mg/m\^2 is administered weekly on Day 1, 8, 15 of each 28-day cycle.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo: The subjects will receive IV dose of placebo matched to B013 on Day 1 and 15 of the first 28-day cycle, then on Day 1 of each subsequent 28-day cycle.

primaryOutcomes.description: From the date of randomization to the date of progression disease or death , whichever occurred first.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Tumor response will be evaluated according to the Response Evaluation Criteria Solid Tumors (RECIST) criteria version 1.1.
DCR was defined as the percentage of participants who have achieved complete response, partial response and stable disease.

DOR was defined for participants who had an objective response as the time from the first occurrence of a documented unconfirmed response (CR or PR) to the date of disease progression per RECIST v1.1 or death from any cause.
Determination of the overall survival times of all participants.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events (TEAEs) and Serious Adverse Events (SAEs)
secondaryOutcomes.description: The incidence of adverse event (regardless of its relationship to study drug) will be classified using MedDRA and the severity of each adverse event will be graded using NCI CTCAE v5.0.
